lines: d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Ricardo Figueroa is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d41: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d41: 🕯️ Ricardo Figueroa is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d41: What Ricardo kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d41: "Ricardo's gone." Oscar looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Ricardo." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d41: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Ruby blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Swimmer (Level 1). Cross water freely. Rivers are roads to you.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Herbal Medicine (Level 1). Willow bark = aspirin. Yarrow stops bleeding. Plantain draws out infection. The pharmacy is outside.
d41: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Ricardo Figueroa, 41 days. The mantle passes to Ruby Callaghan.
d41: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Ruby Callaghan, 24 — a lifeguard. Her hands know different work now: Bloodhound, Lucky Rock, Trophy Room.
d41: ◈ The System updates its file: the new bearer <redacted> "Stalker of the Apex Predator." It had a word for this one before the Codex came.
d41: The village's quarrel was with Ricardo — and Ricardo is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d41: At the grave, Kate, Oscar, Aisling and 4 more speak for Ruby — "Ricardo trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d41: The fire knew Ruby before the Codex did — her name already carried weight here.
